title: Audit environnemental et social des sites du Groupe Chimique Tunisien – Site de Gabès (rapport définitif)
institution: Groupement I2E / IHE, for Groupe Chimique Tunisien
summary: 160-page audit of the Gabès site against Tunisian regulations and the African Development Bank safeguards, prepared by consultants for the Groupe Chimique Tunisien. This archive lists only the 17 items the audit rates 'Non-conformité majeure': 10 cite a Tunisian law or standard and 7 cite only the bank's safeguards. In French.

findings.headline: Water discharges: audit lists norm exceedances for temperature, pH, fluoride and phosphorus, with no monitoring procedure
findings.summary: The audit rates discharge of effluents above norms for temperature, pH, fluoride and phosphorus as a major non-conformity, and notes that no operating or monitoring procedure is available.
findings.intro: The audit checks the Gabès site against Tunisian standards and the African Development Bank safeguards. For water discharges it lists exceedances of norms for temperature, pH, fluoride and phosphorus and finds no procedure to control or monitor them. It rates this a major non-conformity.
findings.quote: Aucune procédure opérationnelle ou de suivi n’est disponible.
findings.explanation: The audit says nothing defines which parameters to check, how often, who is responsible, or what to do when a threshold is passed.
findings.limitations: The summary row gives no measured values; the exceedance is stated in the criterion's title. The audit's detailed comment (p. 71) describes the lack of documented control. A rating in an audit is not a court ruling.

corrective_action.action: Install fluoride recovery and recycling equipment on the phosphoric acid process (flash cooler and closed water loop); the recovered fluoride would be used to make hydrofluoric acid.

findings.headline: Marine ecosystems: untreated discharges may affect marine biodiversity
findings.summary: The audit rates the impact of untreated discharges on coastal marine biodiversity as a major non-conformity and calls for a specific ecological assessment.
findings.intro: Under the bank's biodiversity safeguard (SO6), the audit looks at the effect of the site's discharges on the sea. It states that untreated discharges may affect marine biodiversity along the coast and rates this a major non-conformity.
findings.quote: Rejets non traités susceptibles d’affecter la biodiversité marine en zone littorale.
findings.explanation: The audit says the gypsum-water discharge can alter marine ecosystems and that a specific ecological assessment and corrective measures are needed (p. 74).
findings.limitations: The wording is 'susceptibles d’affecter' (may affect). The audit presents no marine measurements in this row. Its reference is a bank safeguard, not a Tunisian law.
findings.reference: SO6 – Conservation de la biodiversité et gestion durable des ressources biologiques

corrective_action.action: Specific ecological assessment and corrective measures.
corrective_action.budget_mdt: Inclus dans le coût d’autre projet

findings.headline: Air: ammonia from the DAP units rated a major non-conformity
findings.summary: The audit rates ammonia (DAP units) as a major non-conformity against the 2010 decree on air and the bank's pollution-prevention safeguards.
findings.intro: The audit checks air emissions at the Gabès site against Décret n° 2010-2519 of 28 September 2010 and the bank's safeguards SO1 and SO3. It records pollution from ammonia (DAP units) and rates it a major non-conformity. The row states the finding but gives no measured value.
findings.quote: Pollution de l’air par les émissions d’Ammoniac des unités DAP
findings.explanation: The audit rates this emission as a serious gap against the cited decree and safeguards. See the audit's air-monitoring finding for the state of measurement.
findings.limitations: The summary row gives no measured value for this pollutant. Ammonia is not among the pollutants in the audit's emission Tables 19 and 21 (pp. 78–79). A rating in an audit is not a court ruling.
findings.reference: Décret n° 2010-2519 du 28 septembre 2010; SO1 – Évaluation et gestion des risques environnementaux et sociaux; SO3 – Prévention de la pollution et utilisation efficiente des ressources

corrective_action.action: Install a gas scrubbing system on the DAP manufacturing processes to reduce ammonia emissions.

findings.quote: Pollution de l’air par les émissions NOx des unités d’Acide Nitrique
findings.explanation: The audit rates this emission as a serious gap against the cited decree and safeguards. See the audit's air-monitoring finding for the state of measurement.
findings.limitations: The summary row gives no measured value for this pollutant. Table 21 (p. 79) lists NO2 at the nitric acid stack U1000 as 924 against a listed limit of 500 (mg/Nm3), phase 'Démarrage'. The audit says exceedances at that unit occurred only during start-up (p. 80). The data come from a 2015 characterisation report. A rating in an audit is not a court ruling.
findings.reference: Décret n° 2010-2519 du 28 septembre 2010; SO1 – Évaluation et gestion des risques environnementaux et sociaux; SO3 – Prévention de la pollution et utilisation efficiente des ressources

corrective_action.action: Install catalytic NOx reduction (DENOX) on the Gabès nitric acid unit.

findings.headline: Workers' noise exposure: several zones exceed the threshold cited by the audit
findings.summary: The audit rates workers' noise exposure as a major non-conformity because several zones are above the threshold it cites.
findings.intro: I2E measured noise at 12 points on the Gabès site on 06/10/2023. The audit says several zones exceed the exposure thresholds and rates this a major non-conformity. Table 22 gives 90 at the central boiler room and 86,6 at the distiller.
findings.quote: Les mesures acoustiques réalisées ont révélé que plusieurs zones du site dépassent les seuils réglementaires d’exposition au bruit

sample.location: 12 points on the Gabès site, incl. near the phosphogypsum dump (Tabia)
sample.method: Measurement campaign by I2E during site visit

standard.name: Daily noise exposure threshold cited in the audit
standard.source_label: Audit, section on acoustic pollution, citing Directive 2003/10/CE and French Décret n°2006-892
standard.comparable_note: Table 22 gives one 'Valeur moy' per measured point; the excerpt shows no unit and does not say it is a full working-day exposure average, so it is not safe to treat it as the same quantity.

findings.explanation: The audit says high noise puts workers at risk of hearing damage and needs urgent action on noise sources (p. 88).
findings.limitations: Table 22 values are point means: 90 (central boiler room), 86,6 (distiller), 84,45 (boiler), 82,9 (central unit); others are lower. The thresholds cited are a European directive and a French decree. Note: the summary row lists only bank safeguards as its reference.
also_in: Detailed assessment, p. 86 (PDF p. 99) and p. 88 (PDF p. 101)

corrective_action.action: Install signage, personal protective equipment and acoustic barriers.

findings.headline: Installation safety: important design and maintenance defects
findings.summary: The audit rates important safety defects in the design and maintenance of installations as a major non-conformity.
findings.intro: Under the bank's health and safety safeguards, the audit reviews how safely the installations are designed and maintained. It records important defects and rates this a major non-conformity.
findings.quote: Défauts importants de sécurité liés à la conception et à la maintenance des installations
findings.explanation: The audit's comment calls these failures a dangerous design and a serious breach of the duty to protect workers' health and safety (p. 91).
findings.limitations: The summary row does not name the specific installations or defects. Its reference is a bank safeguard, not a Tunisian law.

corrective_action.action: Set up a compliance programme for the installations.

findings.headline: Residents: recurring gas, dust and sulphur-smell nuisance, with no assessment or management plan
findings.summary: The audit rates the lack of a participatory assessment or social-impact plan for residents' reported nuisances as a major non-conformity.
findings.intro: The audit records that residents report recurring nuisances from gas, dust and sulphur odours. It finds that no participatory assessment or specific plan for managing the social impacts was put in place, and rates this a major non-conformity.
findings.quote: Les riverains déclarent des nuisances récurrentes liées aux émissions atmosphériques (gaz, poussières, odeurs soufrées), sans qu’une évaluation participative ni un plan spécifique de gestion des impacts sociaux n’ait été mis en œuvre.
findings.explanation: The failing the audit rates is the lack of a system to take residents' experience into account, not a measured level of pollution.
findings.limitations: These are nuisances declared by residents; the row gives no measurements.

corrective_action.action: Create a community liaison committee and a complaints register.

findings.headline: Residents report asphyxia, respiratory irritation and chronic discomfort linked to the site's emissions
findings.summary: The audit records residents' reports of asphyxia and respiratory problems and rates the health risk to nearby populations as a major non-conformity.
findings.intro: The audit records that residents report cases of asphyxia, respiratory irritation and chronic discomfort in connection with the site's air emissions. It rates the health risk to nearby populations a major non-conformity. It recommends a health impact study.
findings.quote: Des cas d’asphyxie, d’irritations respiratoires et d’inconfort chronique sont rapportés par les riverains, en lien avec les rejets atmosphériques du site.
findings.explanation: The audit says the health effects mentioned, if confirmed, would be a direct harm to public health, and that a health impact study and reduction measures are needed (p. 93).
findings.limitations: These are cases reported by residents. The audit gives no medical data and says 'if confirmed' (p. 93), so they are not established health findings.

corrective_action.action: Carry out a health impact study and compensatory measures.

findings.headline: Residents say they are not informed or consulted; no formal mechanism exists
findings.summary: The audit rates the lack of any formal mechanism for informing and consulting residents as a major non-conformity.
findings.intro: Residents say they are not sufficiently informed or consulted. The audit found no formal communication or community participation mechanism and rates this a major non-conformity under the bank's stakeholder-engagement safeguard.
findings.quote: Les riverains estiment ne pas être suffisamment informés ni consultés. Aucun mécanisme formel de communication ou de participation communautaire n’a été identifié.
findings.explanation: The audit says a complaints mechanism, a liaison committee or regular consultations are essential to restore trust (p. 93).
findings.limitations: The residents' view is reported by the audit; the finding that no mechanism was identified is the audit's own.

corrective_action.action: Hold periodic meetings and publish environmental information.

findings.headline: No proof of operating authorisations was presented
findings.summary: The audit rates the absence of information on operating authorisations for the installations as a major non-conformity.
findings.intro: Under the law on classified establishments, installations need operating authorisations. The audit says no document proving authorisation to operate was presented, and rates this a major non-conformity.
findings.quote: Aucun document justificatif relatif à l’autorisation d’exploiter n’a été présenté.
findings.explanation: The audit does not say authorisations are missing. It says no proof was shown to the auditors.
findings.limitations: Absence of documents shown is not proof that no authorisation exists. A rating in an audit is not a court ruling.

corrective_action.action: Inventory the classified installations, verify existing authorisations and create a register of regulatory authorisations by site and activity.

findings.headline: No hazard study for ammonium nitrate
findings.summary: The audit rates the lack of a specific hazard study for ammonium nitrate as a major non-conformity.
findings.intro: The audit checks the site against the Tunisian Labour Code. It finds no hazard study specific to ammonium nitrate and rates this a major non-conformity.
findings.quote: Absence d’étude des dangers spécifiques liés à l’ammonitrate
findings.explanation: The audit's comment says the risk has not been assessed specifically despite the presence of hazardous substances (p. 95).
findings.limitations: The row does not say that an accident occurred. A rating in an audit is not a court ruling.

findings.headline: Air emissions: no measurement campaign since March 2010 identified
findings.summary: The audit says no air-emission measurement campaign more recent than March 2010 was identified and rates the lack of continuous monitoring a major non-conformity.
findings.intro: The audit says its air-monitoring basis is a single study from 2010 with no updated continuous monitoring. It rates this a major non-conformity because it touches both public health and air pollution. Without monitoring, the audit says risks cannot be managed proactively.
findings.quote: aucune campagne de mesures plus récente que celle réalisée en mars 2010 n’a été identifiée.
findings.explanation: The audit says the lack of continuous monitoring prevents proactive risk management and goes against the bank's performance standards (p. 80).
findings.limitations: Note: the summary table (p. 8) has a row on the absence of a structured monitoring system, with the same SO1 and SO3 references, rated 'Non-conformité mineure'. The detailed section (p. 80) rates it major. The audit's emission tables come from a 2015 characterisation report, and the audit says the exceedances it lists occurred only during start-up (p. 80).
